subject: Pilot pause due to integration maintenance — request for sandbox padding
messages:
From: Alex Geller <alex@luminata.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Aug 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot paused — need a short sandbox top-up to keep the demo slot

Hi Jasmine,

Quick note from our side — we hit a mandatory maintenance window on our connector that unexpectedly delayed the end-to-end tests. Engineering pushed a shorter fix to QA but it looks like the production rollout will slip by ~10 business days.

We still want to keep the demo with our execs on Sept 9 but without extra runway the team will run out of sandbox capacity for the live flows. Would Redwood be able to offer a short-term sandbox/top-up or extend our pilot credits so we can hold the demo date? We don’t need a long-term concession — just enough to run a few full-scale scenarios next week and the demo.

Deal details: Luminata (LD-4872). Procurement copied: procurement@luminata.io

Appreciate any quick help here.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Geller
Head of Integration, Luminata
alex@luminata.io
+1 415-555-0143

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Alex Geller <alex@luminata.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot paused — need a short sandbox top-up to keep the demo slot

Alex — thanks for the heads up and sorry to hear about the connector maintenance. We want to avoid moving the exec demo if possible. I’m escalating this to Ben and looping in CS (Marissa) so we can make a quick decision.

Can you confirm two things so I can speed this to approval:
- The approximate peak token volume and number of full-run flows you expect for the demo day (ballpark numbers are fine).
- A firm demo date/time (looks like you mentioned Sept 9 — can you confirm timezone & time).

My ask to Ben will be: a short-term sandbox credit to cover full-run scenarios for one demo + a week of smoke testing (we typically approve limited top-ups for integration stalls). Marissa — can you advise on whether we can temporarily increase concurrent sessions for Luminata during that week?

I’ll follow up once Ben confirms the amount and legal signs off on the usual one-time authorization.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Office: +1 650-555-0224

Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot paused — need a short sandbox top-up to keep the demo slot

Thanks for flagging, Jas. Based on a quick look at Luminata’s usage profile and the usual ask, I’m comfortable approving a one-time sandbox credit equivalent to a 14-day runway for their current SKU — conditional on 1) Marissa confirming we can temporarily raise concurrent session cap and 2) procurement signing the simple authorization form.

Proposal:
- Sandbox credit: $3,500 equivalent (consumable in the sandbox/pilot environment only)
- Duration: credits to be applied immediately and expire 21 days after issuance
- Conditions: no long-term price changes; authorization form signed; normal abuse and TOS apply

Marissa — please confirm the session cap and any operational notes. Connor — loop in Billing to prepare the credit voucher and the standard authorizing doc (I can provide language). Once we have those, Jasmine can push to Alex and procurement to sign.

Ben Carter
Sales Director, West
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Alex / procurement — good news: Ben approved a one-time sandbox credit to help cover the demo runs and a short smoke-testing window. Details below 

What we’re approving:
- Credit: $3,500 sandbox credit applied to Luminata pilot (LD-4872)
- Validity: Issued immediately, usable for 21 days from the date of issuance
- Scope: Sandbox environment only (full production unaffected)
- Operational note: We’ll temporarily raise the concurrent session cap by 20% for the requested demo week. Marissa will confirm technical details.

Next steps:
1) Procurement: please review and sign the attached authorization (sandbox-credit-authorization.pdf) — I’ve also dropped a DocuSign link below for convenience.
2) Once signed, Connor/Billing will issue the credit voucher and enable the cap change.
3) Please confirm exact demo run volumes as soon as you have them so we can monitor consumption.

DocuSign (one-click): https://www.docusign.com/sign/XYZ-LL-2027-08-31
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/LD-4872

Attachments: sandbox-credit-authorization.pdf (stub)

Happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk through the authorization.
